generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 full-screen key art background for a fantasy expedition strategy game's main menu
Input images: Image 1 is a style and palette reference only; match its detailed hand-authored pixel-art language, nocturnal navy atmosphere, warm amber practical lights, teal magical accents, stone-and-wood material vocabulary, and isometric-fantasy mood. Do not copy its exact camp layout.
Primary request: create an original moonlit expedition departure scene on a high ruined mountain pass: a small caravan and banner preparing to leave through an ancient stone gate toward distant peaks, with a subtle magical waypoint glow and a strong sense of journey.
Composition/framing: wide cinematic 16:9 landscape; keep the rightmost 34% visually quiet and dark enough for a translucent vertical menu panel; keep the upper-left 32% low-detail and high-contrast enough for a large title; place the main focal caravan and illuminated gate in the left-center/lower-center; no important subject at the extreme edges.
Lighting/mood: calm before departure, adventurous, mysterious, premium game key art; deep blue night and pre-dawn violet sky, restrained warm firelight, small teal rune accents.
Style/medium: crisp high-detail pixel art with intentional clusters and readable silhouettes, consistent with the reference asset's production quality; no painterly blur, no photorealism, no 3D render.
Text: none.
Constraints: no UI, no logo, no lettering, no watermark, no readable symbols, no modern objects, no close-up character portrait, no exact duplication of Image 1.

selection.reason: The right third is naturally dark for the action panel, the left-center carries the expedition focal point, and the asset contains no embedded text or UI.
